title: Decision-tree depth respects pointwise equality
statement: Let $f$ and $g$ be Boolean functions of $n$ variables, that is, maps $\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$, and suppose they agree on every input, so $f(x) = g(x)$ for all $x \in \{0,1\}^n$. Then $f$ and $g$ have the same decision-tree depth.
hypotheses_covered: f and g are Boolean functions of n variables
f and g agree pointwise: f(x) = g(x) for every input x
replaced:
If two Boolean functions $f$ and $g$ agree at every input, then they have the same
decision-tree depth: $\mathrm{dtDepth}\,f = \mathrm{dtDepth}\,g$.
